verdict.rationale: SES supports event-driven, background-running integrations (Lambda triggers on inbound mail, SNS/EventBridge event publishing, autoresponders/ticketing pipelines) that can run without manual intervention, but this is generic email-infrastructure automation via other AWS services rather than a native, AI-agent-oriented automation/orchestration capability built into SES itself. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/workflow engine, AI-agent-specific automation tooling, and evidence of multi-step autonomous orchestration beyond simple trigger-to-Lambda/SNS hooks.
